subject: PO assignment request: Acero Systems onboarding
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acero.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acero.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO request for onboarding / spend caps

Hi Monica / Ben,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. We're ready to move to the next step on Redwood onboarding — we need a purchase order issued so our finance team can set payment terms. Attached is our completed onboarding form (acero_onboarding_form.pdf) and a first-pass line item spreadsheet. A few specifics: 

- Total initial committed spend: $95,000 across first 6 months
- Preferred split: Compute / Dedicated capacity (70%), Hosted API (30%)
- We need a provisional PO number while our internal PO gets routed; can Redwood issue a provisional/pending PO so invoices can be applied to it?
- Our procurement team requires the PO to include a spend cap and a per-invoice line-item breakdown (they will reject aggregate-only PO).

Jason Lee
Head of Ops, Acero Systems
jason.lee@acero.com
Attachment: acero_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acero.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request for onboarding / spend caps

Thanks Jason — great to meet earlier. Quick checklist before I push a provisional PO: 

1) I don't see a tax ID in the onboarding form; procurement will need that on the PO. Could you confirm Acero's tax id (EIN) and billing address?
2) Can you confirm the full line-item breakdown you want on the PO (we can break out Dedicated GPU pool as a single line with a spend cap, plus a Hosted API line). If you prefer, attach an updated XLS with the columns: description, qty, unit_price, account_code.
3) We can issue a provisional PO number (P-XXXXX-PROV) for your initial invoices; provisional POs are valid for 45 days.

Assuming we get the tax id + updated line items I'll create the provisional PO and set a spend cap at the committed amount you listed, with the ability to toggle the cap up after final PO is issued. Karthik — looping you for line-item validation and ledger mapping (we need to ensure the SKU codes map to Acero's billing profile).

Monica Patel
Program Manager, Procurement Enablement
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acero.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acero.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request for onboarding / spend caps

On Mon, Dec 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jason — great to meet earlier. Quick checklist before I push a provisional PO: 
> 
> 1) I don't see a tax ID in the onboarding form; procurement will need that on the PO. Could you confirm Acero's tax id (EIN) and billing address?
> 2) Can you confirm the full line-item breakdown you want on the PO (we can break out Dedicated GPU pool as a single line with a spend cap, plus a Hosted API line). If you prefer, attach an updated XLS with the columns: description, qty, unit_price, account_code.
> 3) We can issue a provisional PO number (P-XXXXX-PROV) for your initial invoices; provisional POs are valid for 45 days.

Hi Monica — thanks. Attached is the updated line-item file (acero_lineitems_v2.xlsx) and our EIN: 12-3456789. Billing address: 320 Meridian Ave, Suite 4, San Mateo, CA 94401.

Line items summary (from the sheet):
- Dedicated GPU pool (monthly reserved) — $11,100 / month (qty 6 months = $66,600)
- Hosted API calls (est. tokens) — lumped line with monthly cap $4,900 / month (qty 6 months = $29,400)

Total equals the $95k committed. We need the per-line spend caps shown on the PO so our AP team can route invoices correctly.

Jason Lee
Attachment: acero_lineitems_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acero.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request for onboarding / spend caps

Thanks Jason — received the EIN and the updated XLS. I've created a provisional PO and applied the per-line spend caps you requested. Details below and ticket links for your finance team: 

Provisional PO: P-20261216-ACERO-PROV
Validity: 45 days (expires 2027-01-30)
Spend cap (per-line):
  - Dedicated GPU pool: cap $66,600 (ledger mapping: SKU-DED-GPU / acct 4102)
  - Hosted API calls: cap $29,400 (ledger mapping: SKU-HOST-API / acct 4201)
Total provisional cap: $96,000 (we added a $1,000 buffer to avoid invoice rejections — happy to remove if you prefer).

NOTE: During ticket validation Karthik found a small mismatch between the sheet's account_code values and our ledger. We've corrected the mapping in our system (change recorded in PROC-1845). This means the line item descriptions on the final PO will be normalized to Redwood SKU labels; the values and caps are unchanged. 

Attachments: provisional PO stub (ponum_provisional.txt) and a PDF copy saved to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acero/OnboardingPacket.

Next steps:
- Jason/procurement: confirm whether you want the $1,000 buffer removed (we can issue a revised provisional PO within 24 hours).
- Finance: once your internal PO number is available, reply with the PO number and we'll convert the provisional PO to the final PO (keeps historical mapping).

If everything looks good I'll mark the onboarding ticket as "provisional PO issued" and push the ledger change to staging for invoicing.

Monica Patel
Program Manager, Procurement Enablement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: ponum_provisional.txt (text/plain)
